name: BeamMP (BeamNG.drive)
author: ops@refx.example
description: Multiplayer for BeamNG.drive via the open-source BeamMP mod. Standalone lightweight server — physics run on players' machines, so it boots fast and runs lean.

installScript.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ReFx installer for BeamMP (the BeamNG.drive multiplayer server).
# The server is a standalone binary from GitHub releases — no SteamCMD, no game
# files, no Steam login. Idempotent: safe to re-run on an existing server; the
# customer's ServerConfig.toml edits, Resources/ mods and logs are preserved.
set -uo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

# ---- Resolve the release tag (default: latest stable) ----------------------
VER="${BEAMMP_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ -z "$VER" ] || [ "$VER" = "latest" ]; then
  TAG="$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/latest \
    | grep -oE '"tag_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*"(v[^"]+)".*/\1/')"
else
  case "$VER" in v*) TAG="$VER";; *) TAG="v$VER";; esac
fi
[ -n "${TAG:-}" ] || { echo "[refx] ERROR: could not resolve a BeamMP-Server release tag (GitHub API unreachable?)"; exit 1; }
echo "[refx] installing BeamMP-Server $TAG"

# ---- Download the Linux binary (runtime image is Debian 12/bookworm) -------
# Assets are named BeamMP-Server.<distro>.<version>.x86_64; try newest-matching
# first. HARD-FAIL if none downloads — never claim success on a missing binary.
DL=""
for ASSET in "BeamMP-Server.debian.12.x86_64" "BeamMP-Server.debian.11.x86_64" "BeamMP-Server.ubuntu.22.04.x86_64"; do
  if curl -fsSL -o /tmp/BeamMP-Server "https://github.com/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/download/$TAG/$ASSET"; then
    DL="$ASSET"; break
  fi
done
[ -n "$DL" ] || { echo "[refx] ERROR: no Linux BeamMP-Server asset found for $TAG"; exit 1; }
mv /tmp/BeamMP-Server ./BeamMP-Server && chmod +x ./BeamMP-Server
echo "[refx] downloaded $DL"

# ---- Bundle liblua5.3 (BeamMP's Lua plugin runtime; not in the game image) --
# The startup command runs with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./libs so the runtime container
# never needs root/apt. Install containers run as root, so fetch it here.
mkdir -p libs
if ! ls libs/liblua5.3.so* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ( cd /tmp \
    && apt-get update -qq \
    && apt-get download -qq liblua5.3-0 \
    && dpkg-deb -x liblua5.3-0_*.deb /tmp/lua-extract ) \
  && cp -v /tmp/lua-extract/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/liblua5.3.so* libs/ 2>/dev/null || true
fi
ls libs/liblua5.3.so* >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[refx] ERROR: liblua5.3 could not be bundled — BeamMP-Server cannot start without it"; exit 1; }

# Mods live here: Resources/Client is auto-distributed to joining players.
mkdir -p Resources/Server Resources/Client

# ---- Seed a fresh ServerConfig.toml (first install only) --------------------
CFG=ServerConfig.toml
if [ ! -f "$CFG" ]; then
  cat > "$CFG" <<'TOML'
[General]
Name = "A ReFx Hosting BeamMP Server"
Port = 30814
AuthKey = ""
Private = true
MaxCars = 1
MaxPlayers = 8
Map = "/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json"
Description = "BeamMP Default Description"
Tags = "Freeroam"
Debug = false
ResourceFolder = "Resources"
LogChat = true
TOML
  echo "[refx] seeded a fresh ServerConfig.toml"
fi

# ---- Write the boot launcher ------------------------------------------------
# BeamMP reads ServerConfig.toml once at startup and has no CLI/env overrides,
# so the launcher syncs the panel-owned keys (the Startup tab's variables) into
# the config ON EVERY BOOT — save a variable, restart, it applies. Everything
# else in the file (Description, Tags, Debug, ...) belongs to the customer and
# is never touched. The heredoc is quoted: env is read at BOOT, not install.
cat > refx-run.sh <<'RUNEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# ReFx launcher for BeamMP: apply Startup-tab variables to ServerConfig.toml,
# then exec the server (liblua is bundled in ./libs by the installer).
set -u
cd /home/container 2>/dev/null || cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CFG=ServerConfig.toml
[ -f "$CFG" ] || printf '[General]\n' > "$CFG"
esc()  { printf '%s' "$1" | tr -d '"[:cntrl:]|&'; }
num()  { printf '%s' "$1" | tr -cd '0-9'; }
bool() { case "$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in 1|true|yes|on) printf 'true';; *) printf 'false';; esac; }
set_key() { # $1 = TOML key, $2 = raw TOML value (already quoted if a string)
  if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$1[[:space:]]*=" "$CFG"; then
    sed -i -E "s|^[[:space:]]*$1[[:space:]]*=.*|$1 = $2|" "$CFG"
  else
    sed -i "/^\[General\]/a $1 = $2" "$CFG"
  fi
}
set_key Name "\"$(esc "${SERVER_NAME:-A ReFx Hosting BeamMP Server}")\""
p="$(num "${SERVER_PORT:-30814}")"; [ -n "$p" ] && set_key Port "$p"
if [ -n "${AUTH_KEY:-}" ]; then
  set_key AuthKey "\"$(esc "$AUTH_KEY")\""
else
  echo "[refx] WARNING: no AuthKey set — players cannot join. Get a FREE key at"
  echo "[refx] https://keymaster.beammp.com, paste it into Startup -> BeamMP Auth Key, and restart."
fi
mp="$(num "${MAX_PLAYERS:-8}")"; [ -n "$mp" ] && set_key MaxPlayers "$mp"
mc="$(num "${MAX_CARS:-1}")";    [ -n "$mc" ] && set_key MaxCars "$mc"
set_key Map "\"$(esc "${MAP:-/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json}")\""
set_key Private "$(bool "${PRIVATE:-true}")"
echo "[refx] ServerConfig.toml synced (Name, Port${AUTH_KEY:+, AuthKey}, MaxPlayers, MaxCars, Map, Private)"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/libs${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
exec ./BeamMP-Server
RUNEOF
chmod +x refx-run.sh
echo "[refx] launcher written (Startup-tab settings apply on every restart)."
echo 'BeamMP install complete.'

variables.description: Name shown in the BeamMP server list. Panel-managed: applied to ServerConfig.toml on every restart.

Your personal BeamMP AuthKey — get one FREE at keymaster.beammp.com (Discord login). One key per server; players cannot join without it. Applied to ServerConfig.toml on every restart; leave blank to manage it in the file yourself.
Maximum concurrent players. Panel-managed: applied to ServerConfig.toml on every restart.
How many vehicles each player may spawn (MaxCars). Higher values increase client load.
Level path, e.g. /levels/gridmap_v2/info.json or /levels/west_coast_usa/info.json. Custom maps: upload the mod zip to Resources/Client and use its level path.
true keeps the server OFF the public BeamMP server list (join via Direct Connect); false lists it publicly.
BeamMP-Server release to install: latest, or a pin like v3.9.3 (applied at install/update).

longDescription: Host BeamMP — synced multiplayer for BeamNG.drive. The server is a lightweight relay (soft-body physics run on each player's machine), so it's fast to boot and easy on resources. Auto-distributes your mods and custom maps to joining players from the Resources folder.
